flow_name: Manage - Organizational Details - Trade Licence Document

prerequisite_flows._why: This flow starts signed in. The compiler runs these sign-in steps first when a case does not sign in itself; the Test Data names match the Journey KB role profile (TESTDATA_DEFAULT_ORG_EMAIL, TESTDATA_OTP).

After the OTP sign-in the portal lands on the Dashboard; the Trade License card and 'view & update details' are on Manage > Organization Details. Opening Manage first lets a case start at the card. Clicking Manage again later is harmless.

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Authenticated B2B Portal -> Manage (Organization Details tab) -> Trade License card -> 'view & update details' -> Trade License Details modal (number, company/trade name, sector, emirate, issue and expiry dates, issuing authority, document preview, Download) -> Close -> sign out.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Netcracker (Trade Licence metadata) and EDMS (binary documents) are upstream systems reached only through the B2B Microservice. Assert what the portal renders; never call them directly.

canonical_steps.action: Sign in to the B2B Portal as an Organization Administrator
canonical_steps.expected_result: The authenticated B2B Portal home page is displayed
canonical_steps._see_also: flow_b2b_login_otp carries the authentication steps in full. Deliberately not spelled out in this action text: the step matcher scores canonical steps by word overlap, and an action mentioning RECEIVE OTP here swallowed the real OTP steps of any case that used this flow.

canonical_steps.expected_result: The Manage page opens on the Organization Details tab

canonical_steps.action: Open Organizational Details via the 'view & update details' link
canonical_steps.expected_result: A Loading indicator shows, then the Trade License Details modal opens

canonical_steps.action: Verify the Trade License details shown: Trade License number, column, company name, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority and document preview
canonical_steps.expected_result: The 'Trade License Details' modal shows Trade License Number, Company/ Trade Name, Sector, Emirate, Issue Date, Expiry Date, Issuing Authority and the document preview

canonical_steps.action: Close the Trade Licence document viewer
canonical_steps.expected_result: The modal closes and the Organization Details tab is shown again

canonical_steps.action: Open the company profile menu in the header
canonical_steps.expected_result: The profile menu expands and offers Sign Out

canonical_steps.action: Sign out of the B2B Portal
canonical_steps.expected_result: The session ends and the login page is displayed; a protected route cannot be reached without signing in again

trade_license_column.detail: The Manage Users table has Full Name, ROLE, Contact, status, Manage -- no Trade License column (checked 2026-10-21).

api_contract.detail: Backend orchestration and caching are not observable in the browser; verify at API/integration level.

error_states.detail: Missing/broken document, downstream outage and the 30 s timeout need a backend fault RC cannot be asked for; test manually or with service virtualisation.

unverified_from_brd.note: The verified journey reaches the same licence through Manage -> 'view & update details'. Generate cases for the modal route only when the requirement asks for it, and say in Preconditions that the route is unconfirmed.

fictional_route.detail: The real Users route is /b2bportal/user-manage/user-management (Manage -> Users tab).

tl_number_link_in_users.detail: No TL number in the users table to click; the modal opens only from Organization Details.

tl_column_sort_filter.detail: No TL column, and no column of the users table is sortable today.

organization_without_trade_license.detail: Test data: the RC administrator account's organisation has Trade License 900033; no organisation without a Trade License is available, so the '-'/'N/A' card state cannot be produced. Automate once such an organisation exists in Test Data.

modal_fields_not_in_rc.detail: The Trade License Details modal in RC shows Trade License Number, Company/ Trade Name, Sector, Emirate, Issue Date, Expiry Date and Issuing Authority -- no License Type or Status field (2026-10-21).

unauthorized_user.detail: Test data: Test Data has an Organization Administrator account only; no signed-in user without Trade License access exists to test the negative path.

browser_context_menu.detail: The browser's own right-click menu is outside the page and cannot be read by the automation; and the RC modal offers a Download link.

known_records._note: What RC shows for the organisation the QA account administers (2026-10-21). Expected values only; the account's email and OTP stay in Test Data.

_canonical_steps_note: Verify steps carry no target on purpose: the step matcher lends a verify canonical step's selector to any verify step of a matched case. Assertions come from the label the case quotes; the verified field XPaths are in app_profile.json selectors.trade_license_modal / manage_users.
